definitions.gloss: easy to eat; palatable; not hard to chew or swallow
definitions.explanation: Describing food that is convenient, comfortable, or simple to consume, whether due to size, texture, flavor, or preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一口|ひとくち}サイズ→一口サイズ：23261_hitokuchisaizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食|た}べやすい。
examples.english: It's bite-sized and easy to eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なくて→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧{食|た}べやすい。
examples.english: This fish has few bones and is easy to eat.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{食|た}べやすいよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I cut it into small pieces before serving so that even children could eat it easily.

notes:
Formed from the verb ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to eat) + やすい (easy to do). This is a productive grammatical pattern where verb stem + やすい creates an i-adjective meaning "easy to [verb]." The opposite pattern is verb stem + にくい (hard to do).

USAGE:
- Conjugates as a regular i-adjective: {食|た}べやすく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not easy to eat), {食|た}べやすかった (was easy to eat)
- Can refer to size, texture, flavor mildness, or convenience of a food
- The ～やすい pattern is extremely productive: ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすい (easy to read), ⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧ (easy to use), ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい (easy to understand)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べやすい⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧: an easy-to-eat size
- {食|た}べやすい⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: a mild, palatable flavor
- {食|た}べやすく⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into easy-to-eat pieces
- お⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{食|た}べやすい: easy to eat even for elderly people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧にくい: hard to eat — the opposite; food that is difficult to consume
- ⟦{口当|くちあ}たり→口当たり：21546_kuchiatari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: pleasant to the palate — focuses on flavor and texture
- ⟦{手軽|てがる}→手軽：07176_tegaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: can be eaten easily/casually — focuses on convenience
